biography.summary: A lifelong fisher from Lantern Bay who learned that a good catch means little if the people waiting on shore go hungry. Her patience hides a strong fear of losing someone to the sea.
biography.age_as_of: pre-simulation biography anchor (approximate; not a village day)

eras.description: A child of the shore, taught tides and weather by her father; the bay felt safe and dangerous at once.
Learned fishing under older hands; suffered a frightening storm and began keeping careful tide notes.
Became a dependable fisher and gradually took younger villagers under her wing.
Mentors Ada and Ren, helps sustain the communal pantry, and quietly questions how much duty one person can carry.

nodes.fact: Mother told me I could name the sounds of wind before I could name the boats.
Father took me out in calm water and made me watch the current before I could touch the oars.
We mended nets by the cottage door; most evenings blend into knots, laughter, and salted hands.
I watched a sudden squall turn the quiet inlet white; safety can change between breaths.
